4.desc: The Elation DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprites ignores <unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak> of targets' DEF. For every <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> accumulated Punchline allies gain, the Elation DMG dealt additionally ignores <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak> of targets' DEF, stacking up to <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> time(s).
